sn44.7:1.1: Atha kho Vacchagotto paribbājako yenāyasmā MahāMoggalāno tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Mahā-Moggalānena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn44.7:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārānīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako āyasmantam Mahā-Moggalānam etad avoca || ||
sn44.7:2.1: Kiṃ nu kho Moggalāna sassato loko ti || ||
sn44.7:2.4: Kim pana bho Moggalāna asassato loko ti || ||
sn44.7:2.5: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.7:2.7: Kiṃ nu kho bho Moggalāna antavā loko ti || ||
sn44.7:2.10: Kim pana bho Moggalāna anantavā loko ti || ||
sn44.7:2.11: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.7:2.13: Kiṃ nu kho bho Moggalāna taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti || ||
sn44.7:2.16: Kim pana kho Moggalāna aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīranti || ||
sn44.7:2.17: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.7:2.19: Kiṃ nu kho Moggalāna hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.7:2.22: Kim pana bho Moggalāna na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.7:2.23: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.7:2.24: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 11
sn44.7:2.25: Kiṃ nu kho bho Maggalāna hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.7:2.27: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 12
sn44.7:2.28: Kim pana bho Moggalāna neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.7:2.29: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.7:2.30: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 13
sn44.7:3.1: Ko nu kho bho Moggalāna hetu ko paccayo yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam puṭṭhānam evam vyākaraṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn44.7:3.2: Sassato lokoti vā || Asassato loko ti vā || Antavā loko ti vā || Anantavā loko ti vā || Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran ti va Aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīranti vā || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || || 14
sn44.7:3.3: Ko pana bho Moggalāna hetu ko paccayo yena samaṇassa Gotamassa evaṃ puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti ||
sn44.7:3.4: Sassato loko ti pi || Asassato loko ti pi || Antavā loko ti pi || Anantavā loko ti pi || Tam jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran ti || Aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīran ti pi || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi || Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi ti || || 15
sn44.7:4.1: Aññatitthiyā ca kho Vaccha paribbājakā cakkhum Etam mama eto ham asmi eso me attā ti samanupassanti || sotam || ghānam ||
sn44.7:4.2: jīvham Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || kāyam ||
sn44.7:4.3: manam Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti samanupassanti ||
sn44.7:4.4: tasmā aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam puṭṭhānam evam veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti ||
sn44.7:4.6: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || || 16
sn44.7:4.7: Tathāgato ca kho Vaccha arahaṃ sammāsambuddho cakkhuṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attā ti samanupasati || sotaṃ || ghānaṃ ||
sn44.7:4.8: jivhaṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na me so attā ti || samanupassati || kāyaṃ ||
sn44.7:4.9: manaṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attā ti samanupassati ||
sn44.7:4.10: tasmā tathāgatassa evam puṭṭhassa na evaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti
sn44.7:4.12: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi ti || || 17
sn44.7:5.1: Atha kho Vacchagotto paribbājako uṭṭhayāsanā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn44.7:5.2: sammadanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || 18 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Vacchagotto Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn44.7:5.3: kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama Sassato loko ti || ||
sn44.7:5.4: Avyākatam kho etam Vaccha mayā Sassato loko tipe || || 19-26 || || 27
sn44.7:5.5: Kim pana bho Gotama neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.7:5.6: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam mayā
sn44.7:5.7: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 28
sn44.7:6.1: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam puṭṭhānam evaṃ vyākaraṇam hoti
sn44.7:6.3: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || ||
sn44.7:6.4: Ko pana bho Gotama hetu kho paccayo yena bhoto Gotamassa evam puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti ||
sn44.7:6.6: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pī ti || || 29
sn44.7:7.1: Aññatitthiyā Vaccha paribbājakā cakkhuṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti samanupassanti || pe ||
sn44.7:7.2: jivham Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti samanupassanti || pe || kāyaṃ ||
sn44.7:7.3: manaṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti samanupassanti || ||
sn44.7:7.4: Tasmā aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānaṃ evam puṭṭhānam evam vyākaraṇaṃ hoti ||
sn44.7:7.6: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || || 30
sn44.7:7.7: Tathāgato ca kho Vaccha arahaṃ sammāsambuddho cakkhuṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attā ti samanupassati || sotaṃ || ghānaṃ ||
sn44.7:7.9: manaṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attā ti samanupassati || ||
sn44.7:7.10: Tasmā tathāgatassa evam puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti ||
sn44.7:7.11: Sassato loko ti pi || Asassato loko ti pi || Antavā loko ti pi || Anantavā loko ti pi || Taṃ jivaṃ taṃ sarīranti pi || Aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīranti pi || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi || Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi ti || || 31
sn44.7:8.1: Acchariyam bho Gotama abbhutam bho Gotama
sn44.7:8.2: yatra hi nāma satthussa ca sāvakassa ca atthena attho vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṃsandissati samessati na vihāyissati yadidam aggapadasmiṃ || || 32
sn44.7:8.3: Idānāham bho Gotama samaṇam Mahā-Moggalānam upasaṅkamitvā etam attham apucchiṃ ||
sn44.7:8.4: samaṇo pi Moggalāno etehi padehi etehi vyañjanehi etam atthaṃ vyākāsi seyyathāpi bhavaṃ Gotamo || ||
sn44.7:8.5: Acchariyam bho Gotama abbhutam bho Gotama
sn44.7:8.6: yatra hi nāma satthussa ca sāvakassa ca atthena attho vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṃsandissati samessati na vihāyissati yadidam aggapadasmin
